title: Operators [Arithmetic]
description:
## Arithmetic in Rust
Rust has the standard math operators:
- `+` addition
- `-` subtraction
- `*` multiplication
- `/` division
- `%` modulo (remainder)

```rust
let a: i32 = 10;
let b: i32 = 3;
println!("{}", a + b);  // 13
println!("{}", a / b);  // 3 (integer division!)
println!("{}", a % b);  // 1
```

Note: Rust does NOT have `++` or `--`. Use `x += 1` instead.
